generalAbilities.name: Networked Nodocite
generalAbilities.description: A nodocite can communicate wirelessly with other nodocites within 200 feet.

offensiveAbilities.name: Catchapon
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements A Grabbed, Immobilized, Paralyzed, Restrained, or Unconscious creature is within 15 feet of the nodocite incarcerator

Effect The nodocite incarcerator attempts to inhale the required creature. The target must attempt a DC 18 Fortitude Saving Throw save. On a failure, they're pulled into a miniaturized pocket dimension in a clear polymer ball and stored in the nodocite incarcerator's dorsal chamber.

Each polymer ball weighs light Bulk and contains an individual pocket dimension that can hold one creature of any size at a time. Creatures inside are held in stasis, immune to the effects of time and dying, and are unable to act until released. A nodocite incarcerator can store an unlimited number of polymer balls in its dorsal chamber. When a nodocite incarcerator is destroyed, it automatically Vends all the polymer balls in its dorsal chamber.

A creature within reach of the nodocite incarcerator can attempt a DC 15 Athletics check to Force open dc=15 or a DC 15 Computers , DC 15 Crafting , or DC 15 Thievery check to Disable device dc=15; on a success, rather than the usual effects, the nodocite incarcerator immediately Vends one polymer ball (or two polymer balls on a critical success). It Vends the most recently filled polymer ball.

A creature holding a polymer ball can throw the polymer ball up to 20 feet away as a single action with the manipulate trait, releasing the contained creature into an adjacent space, restored to their normal size and in the state they were when they were captured in the polymer ball.

offensiveAbilities.name: Vend
offensiveAbilities.description: The nodocite incarcerator ejects the most recently filled polymer ball into an adjacent square.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
